papers.title: Information-theoretic Analysis of Test Data Sensitivity in Uncertainty
papers.abstract: Bayesian inference is often utilized for uncertainty quantification tasks. A recent analysis by Xu and Raginsky 2022 rigorously decomposed the predictive uncertainty in Bayesian inference into two uncertainties, called aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties, which represent the inherent randomness in the data-generating process and the variability due to insufficient data, respectively. They analyzed those uncertainties in an information-theoretic way, assuming that the model is well-specified and treating the model's parameters as latent variables. However, the existing information-theoretic analysis of uncertainty cannot explain the widely believed property of uncertainty, known as the sensitivity between the test and training data. It implies that when test data are similar to training data in some sense, the epistemic uncertainty should become small. In this work, we study such uncertainty sensitivity using our novel decomposition method for the predictive uncertainty. Our analysis successfully defines such sensitivity using information-theoretic quantities. Furthermore, we extend the existing analysis of Bayesian meta-learning and show the novel sensitivities among tasks for the first time.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文从信息论角度分析贝叶斯推断的不确定性，但与有限元代理建模或植入物设计的实际应用无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or transferability to biomechanics design; it is a theoretical analysis of Bayesian uncertainty decomposition.

summary_zh.motivation: 从信息论角度分析预测不确定性对测试数据的敏感性
summary_zh.method: 提出一种新的分解方法来量化贝叶斯推断中的不确定性敏感性
summary_zh.result: 成功定义了不确定性敏感性并扩展到贝叶斯元学习
summary_zh.validation: 纯理论推导，无实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To explain the widely believed property that epistemic uncertainty decreases when test data resemble training data, using information-theoretic analysis.
summary_en.method: The authors propose a novel decomposition of predictive uncertainty to define sensitivity in information-theoretic terms.
summary_en.result: The analysis defines test-data sensitivity and extends to Bayesian meta-learning, revealing novel task sensitivities.
summary_en.validation: None; purely theoretical analysis without numerical or empirical validation.

papers.title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning of Argon Gas-Driven Melt Pool Dynamics
papers.abstract: Melt pool dynamics in metal additive manufacturing (AM) is critical to process stability, microstructure formation, and final properties of the printed materials. Physics-based simulation including computational fluid dynamics (CFD) is the dominant approach to predict melt pool dynamics. However, the physics-based simulation approaches suffer from the inherent issue of very high computational cost. This paper provides a physics-informed machine learning (PIML) method by integrating neural networks with the governing physical laws to predict the melt pool dynamics such as temperature, velocity, and pressure without using any training data on velocity. This approach avoids solving the highly non-linear Navier-Stokes equation numerically, which significantly reduces the computational cost. The difficult-to-determine model constants of the governing equations of the melt pool can also be inferred through data-driven discovery. In addition, the physics-informed neural network (PINN) architecture has been optimized for efficient model training. The data-efficient PINN model is attributed to the soft penalty by incorporating governing partial differential equations (PDEs), initial conditions, and boundary conditions in the PINN model.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法虽然应用于增材制造熔池模拟，但其物理信息神经网络框架可迁移至生物力学代理模型，减少昂贵仿真的采样成本。
llm.why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no explicit handling of constraints, and no application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低金属增材制造熔池动力学仿真的高计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 将神经网络与物理定律结合，无需速度训练数据求解Navier-Stokes方程。
summary_zh.result: 高效预测温度、速度和压力，同时发现模型常数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过偏微分方程软约束验证，与仿真结果对比。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational cost of simulating melt pool dynamics in metal additive manufacturing using physics-based CFD.
summary_en.method: The authors propose a physics-informed neural network that integrates governing physical laws without requiring velocity training data, bypassing numerical solution of the Navier-Stokes equation.
summary_en.result: The PINN efficiently predicts temperature, velocity, and pressure fields, and infers difficult-to-determine model constants through data-driven discovery.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated by incorporating PDE residuals, initial conditions, and boundary conditions into the loss function, without external experimental data.

papers.title: Geometry-Aware Adaptation for Pretrained Models
papers.abstract: Machine learning models -- including prominent zero-shot models -- are often trained on datasets whose labels are only a small proportion of a larger label space. Such spaces are commonly equipped with a metric that relates the labels via distances between them. We propose a simple approach to exploit this information to adapt the trained model to reliably predict new classes -- or, in the case of zero-shot prediction, to improve its performance -- without any additional training. Our technique is a drop-in replacement of the standard prediction rule, swapping argmax with the Fréchet mean. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis for this approach, studying (i) learning-theoretic results trading off label space diameter, sample complexity, and model dimension, (ii) characterizations of the full range of scenarios in which it is possible to predict any unobserved class, and (iii) an optimal active learning-like next class selection procedure to obtain optimal training classes for when it is not possible to predict the entire range of unobserved classes. Empirically, using easily-available external metrics, our proposed approach, Loki, gains up to 29.7% relative improvement over SimCLR on ImageNet and scales to hundreds of thousands of classes. When no such metric is available, Loki can use self-derived metrics from class embeddings and obtains a 10.5% improvement on pretrained zero-shot models such as CLIP.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注标签空间中的零样本学习，与FEA代理建模或生物力学设计无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA, surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or any biomechanical implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 预训练模型无法预测训练时未出现的类别。
summary_zh.method: 用Fréchet均值替换argmax，利用标签空间度量。
summary_zh.result: 在ImageNet上提升29.7%，可扩展至数十万类别。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准图像分类基准上测试。

summary_en.motivation: Pretrained models fail to predict unseen classes during training.
summary_en.method: We replace argmax with Fréchet mean to exploit label space metrics.
summary_en.result: Loki achieves up to 29.7% relative improvement on ImageNet and scales to hundreds of thousands of classes.

papers.title: Additively Manufactured K-Band Septum Polarizers: A Comparative Study
papers.abstract: <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$A$</tex> septum waveguide polarizer with integrated circular to square waveguide transition has been manufactured using three different additive manufacturing (AM) processes. Polymer and AlSi10Mg printing processes from a specialized RF manufacturer and a selective laser melting (SLM) process from a university research group are evaluated. Measurements confirm the polarizer design is well suited for AM.

llm.relevance_to_user: 此论文专注于K波段波导极化器的增材制造，与生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、疲劳或骨整合无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper investigates waveguide polarizers for RF applications, with no link to biomedical implants, porous structures, mechanical testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索不同增材制造工艺制作K波段波导极化器的可行性。
summary_zh.method: 使用聚合物和AlSi10Mg三种AM工艺制造，并进行RF测量。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the suitability of different additive manufacturing processes for fabricating K-band septum waveguide polarizers.
summary_en.method: Three AM processes (polymer and AlSi10Mg SLM) were used to fabricate the polarizer with an integrated transition.
summary_en.result: Measurements confirmed that the polarizer design is well-suited for additive manufacturing.
summary_en.validation: RF performance measurements of the fabricated polarizers.
